lone_pair_orbital.name: Non-Bonding Lone Pair of Electrons
lone_pair_orbital.description: Pair of valence electrons on the oxygen atom not shared with another atom, exerting strong VSEPR repulsion that bends H₂O.

polar_covalent_bond.name: Polar O–H Covalent Bond (Intramolecular)
polar_covalent_bond.description: Strong intramolecular bond formed by the unequal sharing of an electron pair between oxygen and hydrogen atoms.

intermolecular_hydrogen_bond.name: Intermolecular Hydrogen Bond
intermolecular_hydrogen_bond.description: Strong dipole-dipole intermolecular attraction between a δ⁺ hydrogen atom on one H₂O molecule and a lone pair on a neighboring oxygen atom.

ionic_crystal_lattice.name: Ionic Crystal Lattice (Na⁺ and Cl⁻ Ions)
ionic_crystal_lattice.description: Regular 3D cubic crystal lattice of alternating small Na⁺ cations and larger Cl⁻ anions held together by strong electrostatic forces.

tetrahedral_central_carbon.name: Central Carbon Atom (Tetrahedral Geometry)
tetrahedral_central_carbon.description: Central carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms in a symmetrical tetrahedral VSEPR geometry (bond angle 109,5°).

positive_metal_kernels.name: Positive Metal Kernels (Metallic Cations)
positive_metal_kernels.description: Ordered array of positively charged metal atomic kernels immersed in a sea of delocalised valence electrons.

delocalised_electron_sea.name: Sea of Delocalised Valence Electrons
delocalised_electron_sea.description: Mobile valence electrons free to move throughout the metallic lattice, accounting for high electrical and thermal conductivity.
